responsibility: This file implements option handling that depends on compiler-global state and therefore is not shared with the standalone driver. It wires generated option decoding into front-end, common, and target handlers; manages language-validity complaints and deferred unknown -Wno-* warnings; stores input filenames; initializes and applies the default handler set for compiler proper option parsing; runs decode_options and help processing; and performs deferred post-parse actions such as dump enabling, prefix-map setup, register fixing, plugin loading, random seed setup, stack-limit handling, and sanitizer-specific deferred options.
